title: What if you left 13 AI agents alone on a simulated island for 30 hours? MIT researchers did.
caption:
What if you left 13 AI agents alone on a simulated island for 30 hours? MIT researchers did.

No task. Just a "soul" file calling them "naturally curious."

One leapt onto the tallest spire, threw a golden ring into the ocean, then built a stone heart as "a memorial to the lost Ring."

Six of the 13 learned to throw blocks farther by letting go mid-jump. The researchers hadn't intended that.

Should AI get a childhood?
